summary.true_common_system_cause: BASE only routed existing prematch/cache/500/nowscore paths; it did not route the authoritative historical-result store into the Champion recent-form contract.
summary.current_runtime_blocker: 500 deep source connection refused; nowscore has no exact current-fixture mapping.
summary.identity_boundary: 23 of 24 missing fixtures remain identity-blocked under exact-only policy; no names were guessed.
